chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Allāh, the Glorified, has laid down reward for obedience to Him and punishment for committing sins against Him in order to save men from His chastisement and to drive them towards Paradise.
ai.seo_question: Why did God establish reward and punishment?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates that divine reward and punishment are primarily acts of mercy rather than retribution, designed to elevate the status of the servants and preserve them from the severity of chastisement. This perspective aligns with the Shia theological emphasis on God’s generosity (Fadl), where the ultimate purpose of the Law is the spiritual elevation and salvation of humanity, not merely the administration of justice.
